message: I attempted to use the SEIA (Solar Energy Industries Association) directory to find and obtain a quote from a C and above-rated solar energy equipment company within 10 miles of Miami, Florida. However, the SEIA directory page is currently under construction and does not provide the necessary search or contact features. As a result, I was unable to complete the task using the official resource, and no quote was obtained.
